checks.duplicate_team_rating: SELECT team_id,moment,COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_team_rating GROUP BY team_id,moment HAVING COUNT(*)>1

source_championship.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("point_win" AS INTEGER) AS "point_win", CAST("point_draw" AS INTEGER) AS "point_draw", CAST("point_loss" AS INTEGER) AS "point_loss"

source_phase.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id", CAST("sort" AS VARCHAR) AS "sort", CAST("bonus_points" AS INTEGER) AS "bonus_points", CAST("bonus_points_threshold" AS INTEGER) AS "bonus_points_threshold"

source_stage_group.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id"

source_team_group.projection: CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", CAST("add_sub" AS INTEGER) AS "add_sub", CAST("bias" AS INTEGER) AS "bias"

source_standing.projection: CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", CAST("position" AS INTEGER) AS "position", CAST("points" AS INTEGER) AS "points", CAST("played" AS INTEGER) AS "played"

source_team.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name"

source_zone.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("first" AS INTEGER) AS "first", CAST("last" AS INTEGER) AS "last", CAST("positions" AS VARCHAR) AS "positions", CAST("color" AS VARCHAR) AS "color"

source_game.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CAST("home_field" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_field", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP) AS "moment", coalesce(sync_status, 'scheduled') IN ('cancelled', 'abandoned', 'awarded') AS "withdrawn", ('x' || substr(replace("home_id"::text, '-', ''), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "home_key_0", ('x' || substr(replace("home_id"::text, '-', ''), 9, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "home_key_1", ('x' || substr(replace("home_id"::text, '-', ''), 17, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "home_key_2", ('x' || substr(replace("home_id"::text, '-', ''), 25, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "home_key_3", ('x' || substr(replace("away_id"::text, '-', ''), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "away_key_0", ('x' || substr(replace("away_id"::text, '-', ''), 9, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "away_key_1", ('x' || substr(replace("away_id"::text, '-', ''), 17, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "away_key_2", ('x' || substr(replace("away_id"::text, '-', ''), 25, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "away_key_3"

source_team_rating.projection: CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", measure_date::date::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 microsecond' AS "moment", "offense"::double precision::real::double precision AS "offense", "defense"::double precision::real::double precision AS "defense", ('x' || substr(replace("team_id"::text, '-', ''), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "team_key_0", ('x' || substr(replace("team_id"::text, '-', ''), 9, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "team_key_1", ('x' || substr(replace("team_id"::text, '-', ''), 17, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "team_key_2", ('x' || substr(replace("team_id"::text, '-', ''), 25, 8))::bit(32)::bigint AS "team_key_3"

groups.partitionQuery: SELECT g.phase_id AS __partition,r.* FROM result_groups r JOIN source_stage_group g ON g.id=r.id

members.partitionQuery: SELECT g.phase_id AS __partition,r.* FROM result_members r JOIN source_stage_group g ON g.id=r.group_id

games.partitionQuery: SELECT g.phase_id AS __partition,r.* FROM result_games r JOIN source_stage_group g ON g.id=r.group_id

zones.partitionQuery: SELECT g.phase_id AS __partition,r.* FROM result_zones r JOIN source_stage_group g ON g.id=r.group_id

source_championship.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("point_win" AS INTEGER) AS "point_win", CAST("point_draw" AS INTEGER) AS "point_draw", CAST("point_loss" AS INTEGER) AS "point_loss" FROM "championship"

source_phase.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id", CAST("sort" AS VARCHAR) AS "sort", CAST("bonus_points" AS INTEGER) AS "bonus_points", CAST("bonus_points_threshold" AS INTEGER) AS "bonus_points_threshold" FROM "phase"

source_stage_group.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id" FROM "stage_group"

source_team_group.query: SELECT CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", CAST("add_sub" AS INTEGER) AS "add_sub", CAST("bias" AS INTEGER) AS "bias" FROM "team_group"

source_standing.query: SELECT CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", CAST("position" AS INTEGER) AS "position", CAST("points" AS INTEGER) AS "points", CAST("played" AS INTEGER) AS "played" FROM "standing"

source_team.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name" FROM "team"

source_zone.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("group_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_id", CAST("first" AS INTEGER) AS "first", CAST("last" AS INTEGER) AS "last", CAST("positions" AS VARCHAR) AS "positions", CAST("color" AS VARCHAR) AS "color" FROM "zone"

source_game.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CAST("home_field" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_field", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", strftime(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS "moment", coalesce(sync_status, 'scheduled') IN ('cancelled', 'abandoned', 'awarded') AS "withdrawn", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(home_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 1, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "home_key_0", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(home_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 9, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "home_key_1", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(home_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 17, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "home_key_2", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(home_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 25, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "home_key_3", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(away_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 1, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "away_key_0", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(away_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 9, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "away_key_1", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(away_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 17, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "away_key_2", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(away_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 25, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "away_key_3" FROM "game"

source_team_rating.query: SELECT CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", strftime(measure_date::DATE::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 1 MICROSECOND, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS "moment", "offense"::DOUBLE::FLOAT::DOUBLE AS "offense", "defense"::DOUBLE::FLOAT::DOUBLE AS "defense", CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, measure_date::DATE) > 1 THEN error('ambiguous team_rating team/day') ELSE CAST('0x' || substr(replace(team_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 1, 8) AS BIGINT) END AS "team_key_0", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(team_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 9, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "team_key_1", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(team_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 17, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "team_key_2", CAST('0x' || substr(replace(team_id::VARCHAR, '-', ''), 25, 8) AS BIGINT) AS "team_key_3" FROM "team_rating"
